name: General tools -> Delivery checklist sync
description: Keeps the Base tool checklist in the [TEMPLATE] Delivery checklist in sync with the Confluence General tools page. Triggered by Confluence Automation (page edited) and a nightly reconcile.

parameters.content:
## General tools -> Delivery checklist sync
Source: Confluence page **General tools** (1540030465). Target: sheet **Base tool checklist** in [TEMPLATE] Delivery checklist.

- Matching uses the sync-owned column **I (Sync key)**; the sync only writes columns I-J and rows it inserts.
- Tool, Status, Status comments, Priority, Owner, Tool setup details and Who has access are never edited.
- New tools are inserted at the end of their existing sheet section, flagged in **J (Sync note)** until Status/Priority/Owner are set.
- Tools gone from the page: kept and flagged if any of Status/Priority/Owner is set, otherwise the row is deleted.
- Runs on Confluence Automation "Page edited" (webhook, secret header x-sync-secret) and nightly at 03:00 as a reconcile.
- Set **dryRun** in Config to preview changes without writing.
